fields.label: Schedule
fields.description: When to run by itself. archive.org profiles kept in step pick up what changed (Manual ones: daily); folders pick up new and changed items. Hourly suits a drop folder.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Internet Archive: pick items on archive.org. Folder or Server: IA-style item folders on this computer, a NAS, or a web server.

fields.label: IA Collection
fields.description: The part after archive.org/details/ for a collection, e.g. ServantsOfKnowledge

fields.label: Narrow With (optional)
fields.description: IA search syntax, e.g. language:(kan OR Kannada) or date:[1900-01-01 TO 1950-12-31] or subject:vachana

fields.label: IA Search Query
fields.description: Any archive.org advanced search query, e.g. creator:(Kuvempu) AND language:kan

fields.label: Identifiers
fields.description: One IA identifier per line.

fields.label: Folder Path or Server URL
fields.description: Folder: /library-source is the folder set as LIBRARY_DIR in .env (any sub-path works, e.g. /library-source/2026). Server: a URL like https://books.example.org/items/ whose sub-folders are IA-style items.

fields.label: Item List URL (optional)
fields.description: A text file listing item folders (one relative path per line). Use it when the server has no directory listing.

fields.label: Link to archive.org When the Item Is There
fields.description: Items already on archive.org use the Internet Archive reader and links; the rest are served from your files.

fields.label: Maximum Items
fields.description: 0 = no limit. Start small (50-500) for a test.

fields.label: Fetch Full Text
fields.description: Download OCR text for full-text and in-book search.

fields.label: Catalogue First, Details Later
fields.description: Lists every matching book on the portal within minutes, from archive.org's search records (thousands of books per request, as the ia command-line tool fetches them); each book's full record and page text then follow in the background.

fields.label: Access for Its Books
fields.options:
Public
Login to read
Login to find
fields.description: Who can see books ingested by this profile. Leave empty to use the rules and default in Settings. Use “Apply Access to Its Books” to change books already ingested.

fields.label: Keep in Step with archive.org
fields.description: After the first run, check archive.org every day (or on the profile's schedule) and bring the catalogue up to date: new books come in, changed ones are updated, removed ones are unpublished. Only what changed is fetched.

fields.label: Keep in Step with archive.org
fields.description: Bring in books added to archive.org since the last check (all of them: Maximum Items applies to the first run only).

fields.label: Update Changed Books
fields.description: Refresh books whose details changed on archive.org. Books with Keep My Edits keep your corrections.

fields.label: Unpublish Removed Books
fields.description: Unpublish books taken out of the collection (or made dark) on archive.org; they come back if they return. Nothing is deleted, and if many books seem to vanish at once nothing is unpublished and managers are alerted.

fields.label: Portal Collection for It
fields.description: Keep a collection page on the portal with this archive.org collection's books, named after it, filled and kept up to date automatically.

fields.label: In Step Up To
fields.description: archive.org changes up to this time are in the catalogue. Set by each completed run.

fields.label: Matching Items on IA
fields.description: Use the Check Count button.
